# API Contracts Checklist: SPEC-014B - Harness Adapter Manifest and Fake Registry

## Route And Envelope

## Authorization And Scope

- [x] CHK004 Are Product Line and Facility scope forms, mixed-scope rejection, and unauthorized resource rejection defined before inventory derivation? [Completeness, Spec §Runtime Inventory API Scope, Contract §Authorization And Scope]

## Filter Vocabulary

- [x] CHK008 Is the `role` query filter source of truth defined as caller-visible project-agent assignment role evidence, with bounded syntax and unknown-role failure behavior? [Resolved, Contract §Query Parameters]
